quotes.author: Lorne Plemel - Kelowna
quotes.text: We had the most amazing time with the Kickin’ Back Boat Rental, the pontoon boat was in excellent condition. There were 15 of us on the boat and we all had an wonderful time from kids sliding down the slide and being pulled behind on the tube – the adults sitting back relaxing – this is something everyone should do and I would highly recommend Kickin’ Back with their professional and courteous service you cannot go wrong.

quotes.author: Maegan Young - Kelowna
quotes.text: We had a fabulous time on the boat! Comfiest seats on the lake! Great for kiddies, adults and seniors!! We celebrated my birthday with my family and it was the perfect way to enjoy the lake with everyone. Very spacious and safe. Great bumping sound system and the slide was a huge hit with all! Thanks!! Can’t wait to go out again!! Highly recommend this boat for memorable time.

quotes.author: Jordan Laventure - Biggar
quotes.text: We rented a pontoon from these awesome people, the pontoon was brand new and absolutely beautiful, the service was second to none! It was so effortless and easy! We had the best time ever, nothing but good things to say! Thank you Kickin Back Boat Rentals for such an awesome experience!

quotes.author: Michaeld - Calgary
quotes.text: Kickin Back was very easy to deal with right through the booking and rental process. I felt the rates were very fair for the product and services delivered. Definitely recommend this company.Michaeld - Calgary, AB

quotes.author: Shelley Berlinski - Grande Prairie
quotes.text: We found the owners very helpful and knowledgeable about the area and where the best boating experience would be. We rented from Kikin Back a few times now and will definitely again. Cheers Kickin Back!

quotes.author: Sophia - Edmonton
quotes.text: I would recommend Kickin Back for the ease of booking, the great response time, attitudes of the employees, and it was all round a great boat!Sophia - Edmonton, AB
